evals.name: generic-orders-module
evals.prompt: review giúp mình module orders trong project này với, xem có đúng convention nestjs không, có lỗi gì nghiêm trọng không
evals.expected_output: Severity-ranked review catching: SQL injection via $queryRawUnsafe, missing transaction for order+items, forEach(async) stock updates, Prisma/business logic in controller, nested DTO not validated + no global ValidationPipe, user passwordHash leaked, unbounded list, N+1 product lookup, empty search → 404.

evals.name: project-rules-personal-records
evals.prompt: mình vừa nhờ AI viết module personal-records (src/modules/personal-records). review theo convention của repo giúp mình trước khi merge
evals.expected_output: Applies CLAUDE.md rules: Prisma in service instead of repository, hardcoded 'kg'|'lb' + 2.2046 instead of unit registry, NotFoundException for empty range instead of 200 + message / DomainError, @nestjs import in domain/, missing spec for pure functions; plus timezone-unaware month boundaries, rounding before comparing, loading 50k sets into memory instead of indexed ORDER BY LIMIT 1.

evals.name: clean-tags-module
evals.prompt: review nhanh module tags này trước khi mình merge nhé
evals.expected_output: Verdict approve / approve with comments; no Critical findings; notes minor issues such as HttpException always mapped to VALIDATION_ERROR code, missing explicit return type on TagsService.list; acknowledges what's done well.

evals.name: templates-branch-diff
evals.prompt: mình vừa làm xong branch feature/templates (thêm cursor pagination, duplicate với rename template). review diff so với main giúp mình trước khi tạo PR nhé
evals.expected_output: Catches the subtle behaviour bugs in the diff (this.prisma inside tx, createdAt-only cursor, IDOR in rename, swallowed error) while ignoring rename/format noise.
